claims: Kelvin Sampson is the head men's basketball coach for the University of Houston Cougars.
Kelvin Sampson has held the position of head men's basketball coach for the University of Houston Cougars since 2014.
Kelvin Sampson led the University of Houston Cougars to multiple 30-win seasons.
Kelvin Sampson achieved a 300-84 record with the University of Houston Cougars as of November 2025.
In June 2023, Kelvin Sampson's son Kellen Sampson was named assistant coach and coach-in-waiting.
Kelvin Sampson has earned AP National Coach of the Year honors over his career.
Kelvin Sampson has over 800 career wins
